D_quarter.expect: trigger-wave scaling v ~ (D/tau)^(1/2) (Hayden 2021): D/4 -> speed x0.5; band 0.4-0.6

pf_sign_mutant.expect: alpha3 -> -alpha3 (Erk suppresses its activator): no propagating wave

step_halved.expect: dt 0.01 -> 0.005 h changes speed and source period by < 5%

synchronous.expect: De Simone 2021 MEASURED that daily tissue-wide synchronous Erk activation (fgf20a, fgf3) impairs scale growth. Here: activator set to 1 over the whole disc every 24 h, source off.
synchronous.note: Reported, not gated. The growth law grows each cell for a fixed window after each of its own Erk peaks, so it cannot tell a wave from a synchronous pulse at equal pulse count; the measured impairment is outside what this layer models.

evidence_kind: SimulationResult (not an observation; not a microscope image)

assumed.form: exponential: d ln(a)/dt = 0.006 per h while t - t_last_peak <= 24 h, compounding
assumed.note: not tuned: the area results are those of the assumed exponential form

measured.quantity: linear slope of normalised cell area after the Erk peak, d(a/a_peak)/dt

first_crossing_h.measured_source: De Simone 2021: 'one wave traverses the entire scale in about 2 days'

front_fwhm_um.measured_source: De Simone 2021: 'a traveling front 50-100 um wide'

rise_10_90_h.measured_source: De Simone 2021: 'activation time of ~3 hours' (single-cell tracks)

source_period_h.measured_source: Hayden 2021: wave generation starts at ~1 wave per day

wave_speed_um_per_h.measured_source: De Simone 2021: 'Erk waves travel at a speed in the order of 10 um/h'

caption: SIMULATED Erk activity on one regenerating zebrafish scale (520 um radius). Model: Hayden et al. 2021, Table 1 parameters.
Growth ASSUMED exponential (d ln a/dt = 0.006/h for an assumed 24 h after each Erk peak); measured: linear slope 0.006/h (De Simone 2021 ED7b).
Rendering of model state in reference (material) coordinates, not a microscope image. Transfer to flying-fish scales unknown.

model: Hayden 2021 Erk trigger-wave reaction-diffusion + wave-gated hypertrophic growth (one scale)
not_claimed: that a flying fish's scales use these kinetics or parameters (all are zebrafish, regenerating scale)
ontogenetic (first-time) scale development: De Simone 2021 show Erk rings in developing juvenile scales, but the parameters are fitted to regeneration
any microscope image: every picture is a rendering of simulated state
growth feedback on waves, scale mineralisation, scale shape beyond a disc, or overlap/imbrication
living or bioprinted fish feasibility; resin props in artifacts/print are display objects
